Gobbl FAQ: price, Mac requirements, dictation, memory, privacy

name: Gobbl
summary: Free open-source notch app for Mac with a file shelf, clipboard, on-device dictation, screen memory and a pet.
description: A free, MIT-licensed macOS notch app built around a pet mascot, Gob. The notch panel holds a drag-and-drop file shelf, clipboard history, Now Playing with synced lyrics, HUDs, a next-meeting calendar and quick tools; it adds on-device Whisper dictation, a write-anywhere key, opt-in screen Memory with self-completing to-dos, and AI agent status with Claude Code permission requests. Needs macOS 14+.
contains: notch panels: shelf, clipboard history (Shift-Command-Space), Now Playing, HUDs, calendar with Join links, quick tools
on-device Whisper dictation: no word cap, no account, ~0.5 s per sentence on Apple silicon
Claude Code permission requests can be allowed or denied from the notch (30 s fallback to the terminal)
opt-in Memory reads on-screen text via macOS Accessibility and stores it on the Mac only
MCP connector registers with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and more
pet: 3 models, 11 hats, shareable .gobskin skins, 6-second clips
macOS 14+, MIT, free during the beta, no account
